messages:
maria_cs: PulsePay (acct PP-78) onboarding: CI smoke test causes spike of preflight 429s on coldstart. GA scheduled Mon. Can we triage?

lee_eng: Are these preflight calls? How many parallel inits and SDK version?

maria_cs: Yes preflight. ~10 concurrent inits per device across runners. SDK mobile-js 0.9.2. Sample log:
```
2026-03-23T08:12:41Z GET /v1/preflight 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 window=60
client: mobile-js/0.9.2 region: us-west-2 X-Client-Time=2026-03-23T08:12:24Z
```

mobile_support: Clock skew (~17s) + no coalescing. Recommend server-time fallback, shared inflight preflight promise, and jittered backoff. Example:
```
let inflight=null
function preflight(){ if(inflight) return inflight; inflight=fetch('/v1/preflight').finally(()=>inflight=null); return inflight }
const backoff=i=>Math.min(800*2**i+Math.random()*200,8000)
```

ops: We can flip PP-78 to onboarding-mode (preflight quota x3 + edge coalescing) for 48h. Need CS approval.

maria_cs: Please enable. I'll ask customer to patch to 0.9.3 and retest.

ops: Onboarding-mode enabled until 2026-03-25T08:12:00Z. Monitoring 1m/5m error rates.

doc-bot: Ticket CS-1410 created: "quickstart: mobile preflight troubleshooting" assigned to lee_eng/docs.

lee_eng: I'll add a "preflight gotchas" section with header checks (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Server-Time) and sample code.

maria_cs: Action items confirmed. Will update account health note: renewal risk flagged if GA misses. Thanks!
